title: Tung Wah Hospital
geometryBasis: Mapped historic Block L, actual assembly-hall entrance visible in the CC0 photo, and six-storey composition and finish identified in the government heritage appraisal.
sectionBasis: Six main storeys with mezzanine, cream scored render, dark multi-pane windows, repeated horizontal bands and flat parapet, with classical entrance porches.
limitations: This May 2025 exterior represents the 1934 Main Block, including the assembly-hall entrance. Modern hospital towers and indoor galleries are outside the scope.
The protected entrance columns, dark doors and steps follow the exact cleared photograph. Upper façade bay counts, roof fixtures, porch positions and the opposite elevations are approximate.
The hillside elevation grid varies sharply around the block and nearby towers. Original relief remains unchanged; paving levels and ground contact are estimates.
